metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the retuned roll, the afternoon bills, and a vault struck out.

yesterday: Juliet stays a third under the note.
Two-and-thirty mornings to the sixth of December. That is the count that was said.
Arthur stood at the back. Nick kept his eyes on the lute.
Wonder of a Woman was the Rose title. The afternoon at the Theatre was Richard III.
The vault was struck. Tomorrow is Paul's.
